status: Proposed scope; technical assessment and quotations pending

ownership.intendedArrangement: Donated machinery and project equipment are intended to belong to Virgin Mary Farm together with Risemeup, for the farm's community purpose, according to founder Iman Tadros.
ownership.documentation: Legal recipient and title, donor conditions, custody, maintenance and transfer or disposal rules require written agreements with the Church and donors before acceptance or delivery.
ownership.land: This intended equipment arrangement does not change the identified Church ownership of the land.

items.name: Well restoration and pumping equipment
items.quantity: 1 initial water-source system, subject to technical assessment
items.purpose: Rehabilitate or replace a destroyed well as advised, and establish water supply for an initial cultivation and training area.
items.specification: Assess the destroyed wells to determine rehabilitation or replacement works, water availability and water quality. Specify the well works and then select pump type, flow, total head and power. Include rising main, cables, protection, fittings and a water meter; sizes to be confirmed.
items.operation: Proposed: a qualified well contractor for restoration and commissioning, then a trained pump operator with supplier servicing. Farm manager Jhone Wadeea is the local management contact; technical operators and maintenance providers remain to be confirmed.

items.name: Solar power and pump controls
items.quantity: 1 matched power package for the initial pump
items.purpose: Provide power for the restored water-pumping system, subject to technical suitability.
items.specification: Panel capacity and controller matched to the selected pump and site conditions; secure mounting, cabling, earthing and electrical protection. No power rating specified before design.
items.operation: Proposed: the trained pump operator for routine checks and a qualified solar technician for servicing. Appointments and service arrangements pending.

items.name: New water storage and filtration
items.quantity: 1 integrated system; tank count and capacity to be determined
items.purpose: Build new water storage for irrigation and protect the irrigation system from blockage.
items.specification: New storage is required. Tank numbers, volume, foundations or supports, filters, valves and pipe sizes must follow the site assessment, water testing and demand calculations. Irrigation use; drinking-water suitability is not established.
items.operation: Proposed: a trained irrigation caretaker with supplier support and a cleaning schedule. Named responsibility and maintenance budget pending.

items.name: Pilot-area irrigation network
items.quantity: 1 initial growing area; hectares and network length to be confirmed
items.purpose: Deliver measured water to crops and support practical irrigation training.
items.specification: Mainlines, distribution pipes, valves and drip equipment sized to the assessed water supply, crop plan and soil. Include fittings, meters and essential spares.
items.operation: Proposed: a local growing team and irrigation caretaker, supported by an agronomist. Names and servicing arrangements pending.

items.name: Growing and training tools
items.quantity: 1 starter package; individual tool quantities depend on the training plan
items.purpose: Enable initial cultivation and supervised sustainable farming education.
items.specification: Hand tools, appropriate protective equipment, basic soil and irrigation monitoring tools and teaching materials. Inventory to be agreed with the local trainer and community representatives.
items.operation: Proposed: a designated trainer and tool custodian, using a sign-out and maintenance register. Appointments pending.
items.cost: Awaiting training plan and supplier quotation

items.name: Secure storage and equipment protection
items.quantity: 1 site protection package; scope to follow the access and security assessment
items.purpose: Protect replacement equipment and provide accountable storage for tools and spares.
items.specification: Assess lockable storage, secure installations, asset identification and practical local custody arrangements. Detailed locations and security measures to remain private.
items.operation: Proposed: a Church-agreed site custodian under an approved asset-management arrangement. Custodian and upkeep responsibility pending.
items.cost: Awaiting site assessment and supplier quotation

budget: Condition survey, test pumping, water testing and design
Well restoration, pump and solar power
Assessed rehabilitation or replacement works, pumping and electrical protection
New tanks, foundations or supports, filters and the initial growing-area network
Transport, applicable charges, installation and commissioning
Secure storage, mounting and locally agreed protection
Operator training, tools, seeds, teaching and supervision
Spares, servicing and an agreed contingency allowance
